about.title: About Deerwood Air Solutions
text: At Deerwood Air & Electrical Solutions, we take pride in keeping Houston homes and businesses running smoothly. For over 30 years, our team has delivered top-quality HVAC and electrical services built on reliability, expertise, and integrity. As a certified Heil Elite Dealer, we offer professional installation, repair, and maintenance solutions designed for comfort, safety, and long-term performance. Whether you need dependable air conditioning, heating, or electrical work, you can count on us to provide honest service and lasting results.

At Deerwood Air & Electrical Solutions, we proudly serve Humble, Kingwood, and Atascocita with reliable HVAC and electrical services. Backed by decades of experience and recognized as a Heil Elite Dealer, our team delivers expert installation, repair, and maintenance built on integrity and trust. From homes to businesses, we provide comfort, safety, and lasting results you can count on.

Jay Twiner is the Owner and Founder of Deerwood Air & Electrical Solutions, bringing over 35 years of experience in HVAC and electrical services. Married and proud of his family, Jay is the father of three sons — one who served in the United States Marines Corps, one who served in the United States Army, and one who is currently serving in the United States Air Force.
